item.tib: stag lha bkra shis gter rdzong las tshe 'gug snang srid bcud 'dus
item.coloph: gyer spungs rad na stag la bsrung ba tshe'i bsgrub pa'i par rgyud las/ tshe 'gugs snang srid bcud 'dus zhes bya ba 'di/ skal ldan las 'brel grogs kyis bskul bas rkyen/ rjes 'jug 'gro bar phan phyir snyigs ma'i kho bo gyer spungs rad nas sbyar ba mu tsug smar ro//
